name: Naturalization for a Foreign Wife of an Iraqi Husband

requirements.blocker_text: Nationality Law No. 26 of 2006, Article 11: a non-Iraqi woman married to an Iraqi man does NOT acquire citizenship automatically (the automatic-acquisition rule was in the repealed 1924 law) -- she must apply to the Minister of Interior after 5 years of marriage, with continuous residence in Iraq throughout, and the marriage still intact at the time of application. Divorced or widowed women who had children with their Iraqi husbands may apply without meeting the full residency requirement. No equivalent provision for a foreign HUSBAND of an Iraqi wife was found in this build -- a real, disclosed asymmetry, not this dataset's assumption.
requirements.fix_path: Marry an Iraqi man, reside continuously in Iraq for 5 years with the marriage intact, and apply to the Minister of Interior.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous residence in Iraq
Proof the marriage remains intact at application

sources.title: Academic comparative-law journal -- Article 11 of Law No. 26 of 2006, foreign wife's naturalization conditions, widow/divorcee exception
